key_insight: RATED improves AI tool retrieval by combining semantic matching with real-time reliability feedback, so agents can avoid failing tools during execution.
engineering_relevance: The method is practical for deployed AI agents because it adapts to API outages with minimal latency and without retraining the base retriever.
method: Frozen dual-encoder for semantic tool-query matching
Contrastive fine-tuning to improve retrieval quality
Lightweight contextual bandit re-ranker uses execution feedback to down-rank unreliable tools
evidence_signal: Evaluated on EcoAgent with 5,172 real-world tools and 210,000+ query-tool pairs; results show a 52.2% relative MRR gain and fault selection rate dropping from 86.2% to 2.9% under 30% outage.
watch_item: The dynamic bandit re-ranking depends on timely execution feedback, so performance may degrade if reliability signals are sparse, delayed, or noisy.
paper_title: RATED: Reliability-Aware AI Agent Tool Retrieval via Execution Dynamics
